newsitem.title: USA: International Speedway buys Phoenix International Raceway.
newsitem.headline: International Speedway buys Phoenix International Raceway.

text.p: International Speedway Corp. said Tuesday it bought the Phoenix International Raceway, a 65,000-seat one-mile oval track, for an estimated $60 million to $67 million.
The seller was Emmett "Buddy" Jobe, who had owned and operated the track since 1985.
The price includes an initial $46.1 million, and applicable taxes which will be paid in several instalments in 1998 and 1999.

International Speedway said it planned to add another 25,000 seats to the Phoenix race track, which would give the Daytona Beach, Fla.-based company more than 400,000 seats at its five largest motorsports facilities.
International Speedway's stock rose 75 cents to $22 early on Nasdaq.
